steps.text: Correct the segmentation: remove the gray-matter labels from the voxels that are not cortex (dura, sinus, membrane, cerebellum) in the manual-edit copy of the segmentation.
steps.paint: Use the label values of the segmentation (voxel edit, not recon edit).

steps.text: If that is not enough, edit mri/brain.finalsurfs.manedit.mgz: mark the voxels that should not be gray matter.
steps.paint: Paint 1 where it should not be gray matter.

steps.text: Correct the segmentation: label the missed cortex as gray matter in the manual-edit copy of the segmentation.
steps.paint: Use the label values of the segmentation (voxel edit, not recon edit).

steps.text: If that is not enough, edit mri/brain.finalsurfs.manedit.mgz: mark the missed voxels.
Correct the segmentation: label the missed white matter as white matter in the manual-edit copy of the segmentation.
steps.paint: Use the label values of the segmentation (voxel edit, not recon edit).

steps.text: If that is not enough, edit mri/wm.mgz (and, if needed, mri/filled.mgz in the same way): fill the white matter the surface does not reach.
steps.paint: Paint 255 to include a voxel in white matter, 1 to exclude it.

steps.text: Correct the segmentation: remove the white-matter labels from the voxels that are not white matter in the manual-edit copy of the segmentation.
steps.paint: Use the label values of the segmentation (voxel edit, not recon edit).

steps.text: If that is not enough, edit mri/wm.mgz (and, if needed, mri/filled.mgz in the same way): remove the voxels that are not white matter.
steps.paint: Paint 255 to include a voxel in white matter, 1 to exclude it.

steps.text: Edit mri/wm.mgz (and, if needed, mri/filled.mgz in the same way) at the defect: fill holes and remove bridges.
steps.paint: Paint 255 to include a voxel in white matter, 1 to exclude it.

steps.text: No dedicated edit is documented for hemispheres that cross. The thing to try is a segmentation edit at this location: correct the labels where the two hemispheres meet in the manual-edit copy of the segmentation.
steps.paint: Use the label values of the segmentation (voxel edit, not recon edit).

fastsurfer.never_edit_note: FastSurfer does not support edits of these; the result is undefined.
cautions: Manual edits can introduce systematic effects. Keep track of which subjects were edited; the export tables record it.
Try the steps in the order given and rerun after each; stop at the first that fixes the surface.
fastsurfer.rerun_note: The rerun must use the same container setup (image, mounts, GPU options) and the same --t1 image as the first run; a different image is an error. With --surf_only the segmentation is not redone.

steps.text: Erase the voxels that are not brain (dura, sinus, membrane, cerebellum) in mri/brain.finalsurfs.manedit.mgz. recon-all 8 removes sinus and dura in this same way. (The older tutorials edit mri/brainmask.mgz for this; in version 8 a full rerun can rebuild that file and lose the edit.)
If the white surface is also short of the white matter here, fix that first: fill the missing white matter in mri/wm.mgz (see the recipe for a white surface short of white matter).
If mri/brain.finalsurfs.mgz has the value 1 here, the sinus or dura mask removed real cortex: paint it back in mri/brain.finalsurfs.manedit.mgz.
Fill the white matter the surface does not reach in mri/wm.mgz.

If the white matter here is darker than 110 in mri/brainmask.mgz, the cause is intensity normalization: add control points instead. In freeview: File > New Point Set, name control.dat, type control points; click voxels that are certainly white matter (never in a lesion); save it as tmp/control.dat in the subject folder.
steps.paint: Control points only in definite white matter with a value below 110.

steps.text: Erase the voxels that are not white matter in mri/wm.mgz.
Look at surf/lh.orig.nofix or surf/rh.orig.nofix at the defect (load it in freeview with File > Load Surface). Fill holes and erase bridges in mri/wm.mgz; one or two voxels can be enough.
steps.paint: Paint 255 to fill a hole; erase to 1 to remove a bridge.

steps.text: No dedicated edit is documented for hemispheres that cross. If the white surfaces cross, erase the voxels that join the hemispheres in mri/wm.mgz.
If only the pial surfaces touch, erase the voxels between them in mri/brain.finalsurfs.manedit.mgz.

never_edit: the cerebellum in mri/brainmask.mgz (it changes the segmentation and later registrations)
freesurfer.never_edit_note: The FreeSurfer tutorials advise against editing these.
cautions: Keep a backup copy of the subject folder before editing. The commands here edit and rerun the subject folder itself.
Edit as little as possible. It is not possible to move a surface directly; an edit changes what the surface is placed from.
If you do not know whether something is an error, leave it alone.
Manual edits can introduce systematic effects. Keep track of which subjects were edited; the export tables record it.
The FreeSurfer editing tutorials were written before version 8. These recipes follow them where the version 8 recon-all script still behaves the same way.
freesurfer.rerun_note: Run the rerun with the same SUBJECTS_DIR and the same FreeSurfer version as the first run.

region_notes.inferior_temporal: Kendrick Kay's note: signal dropout near the ear canal is often not worth fixing.
region_notes.medial_temporal: Kendrick Kay's note: the surfaces around the hippocampus are often not worth fixing.
